findings.title: The installer identity check is skipped when no Integration row exists
findings.body: The identity comparison is reached only after the `Integration.objects.get` lookup succeeds. When the row is absent, the earlier `DoesNotExist` branch calls `pipeline.next_step()` and proceeds with installation without comparing the OAuth user to GitHub’s installer. A delayed or failed installation webhook can therefore leave this path available for connecting an installation using a different GitHub account, defeating the validation this change is intended to enforce.

findings.title: Missing sender metadata causes an unhandled KeyError
findings.body: This directly indexes `integration.metadata["sender"]["login"]`, but `build_integration` only adds `sender` when `state.get("sender")` is present, and existing integrations may not have this metadata. If an Integration exists without an OrganizationIntegration and without sender metadata, setup raises KeyError and returns a 500 instead of handling the installation.
